notes: A playable GTA is one contiguous city roamed in any order, so world-open carries it and Adventure leads on the open world and its missions. Simulation is named second because driving is stated to be core and the mission types are pickup, delivery and drive-to-marker task stations, which is the Role Sim bundle — I took that preset from the secondary genre since its shape is already world-open, and it brings the vehicle-width streets a drivable city needs. Kept two genres rather than three: the third-person combat and police response are explicitly simple and add no Action-specific geometry beyond the city itself. Decided without a user: 'built district by district' plus 'a few connected streets' reads as one continuous surface with a downtown and a residential quarter, not separate maps, so no P4; buildings stay facades since every mission was placed on the streets, keeping this on P0 — enterable Tokyo shops are the obvious upgrade and would cost P3.
